versions.content: A unique order in which multiple spinlocks can be occupied by a Task /Category 2 ISR on one core should be configurable in the AUTOSAR Operat- ing System. This might be realized by the configuration item ( OsSpinlockSucces- sor{NEXT_SPINLOCK} ) where NEXT_SPINLOCK refers to the consecutive spinlock. (See OsSpinlockSuccessor )

Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80018, SRS_Os_80021 A unique order in which multiple spinlocks can be occupied by a Task /Category 2 ISR on one core should be configurable in the AUTOSAR Operating System. This might be realized by the configuration item ( OsSpinlockSuccessor{NEXT_SPINLOCK} ) where NEXT_SPINLOCK refers to the consecutive spinlock. (See OsSpinlockSuc- cessor )
